value.rationale: The weighted analytic Bergman L4/L2 quadratic norm is a natural fixed-band conditioning invariant. The result gives a nonzero sharp 12/beta^2 advantage unavailable to any two-monomial design, resolves persistence for all finite weights, and identifies a universal coalescing-root scaling law as the radial mass concentrates; it is not a mere one-weight recomputation.
